delivery.commit_subject: LOOP-002: add GitHub dispatch workflows for closed-loop coordination

handoffs.message: All four dispatch workflows are ready for review. Pantheon side: .github/workflows/coordination-dispatch-receiver.yml (receives pantheon.frontend_feedback, pantheon.bff_gap, pantheon.ui_done) and .github/workflows/coordination-manual-replay.yml (workflow_dispatch replay). Front-repo templates: .coordination/workflow-templates/pantheon-handoff-receiver.yml and pantheon-feedback-publisher.yml. Protocol fixtures updated: source_commit added, source_repo org-prefixed in bff-gap and ui-done examples. Please verify: validation rules, envelope field coverage, replay guard, front-repo template completeness.
Review passed after tightening dispatch ownership checks, replay validation, and front-repo template completeness. Owner can finalize to done.
